finding.cause: win32.isAbsolute accepts drive-unspecified root paths; win32.normalize preserves non-root trailing separators, so equivalent directory strings could pass as distinct fresh profiles.

repair.accepted: Ordinary fully qualified letter-drive roots or complete UNC server/share roots.
repair.rejected: Root-relative, drive-relative, incomplete UNC, verbatim/device namespace paths.
repair.identity: win32.normalize then inspect the drive/share root; only fully qualified paths enter win32.resolve and lowercase comparison. Non-root trailing separators are removed; roots remain roots.
unchangedGuards: Same60 profiles per target in all11 primary metrics
repair.limits: Pure string qualification/canonicalization; does not authenticate external logs or resolve filesystem symlink/8.3 aliases.
